description: Mirage IIIEA I-014, the last operational Argentine Mirage III, credited with 16 Malvinas-war sorties (four flown by Bariloche-born pilot Jorge Huck); rebuilt with parts of other Mirages at Río Cuarto, mounted on a steel tower over the lakeshore and inaugurated 6 September 2025 as the centrepiece of the memorial building.
